items.html: It thus follows that when the Hassadim and the Gevurot expand below in the Guf [body] of ZA, then the Hassadim are given to ZA, and through them the building of its posterior is completed and finished in wholeness; and the Gevurot are given to the Nukva, as is known, and through them her posterior is completed. And he has a complete posterior and she has a complete posterior, and then they can turn Panim be Panim [face to face], since their posteriors are complete, and the externals now have no ability to grip there — which is not so at first, when this one had half a posterior and that one half, and they were able to grip them. Therefore they can now turn Panim be Panim, for there is no fear of the externals, as we have mentioned in the explanation of the intention of the blessing of the Patriarchs in the weekday Amida. And understand this well. And behold it follows that the benefit of the entry of the Hassadim and the Gevurot into ZA was for two reasons that are one: for they enlarge and complete the posteriors of ZON, and further, that through this they turn Panim be Panim.
